tagline: From GitHub URL to published hackathon submission in 20 minutes
what_it_does: LaunchKit transforms a GitHub repo and hackathon URL into a complete submission package.
how_i_built_it: Built with UiPath Maestro BPMN orchestrating Python Coded Agents that call Gemini 2.0 Flash.
challenges: Devpost has no public API — solved with UiPath RPA browser automation.
accomplishments: Full three-act pipeline with quality gate scoring and human review gates.
what_i_learned: Criteria-first content generation dramatically improves submission quality.
whats_next: Accelerator cohort mode, OSS release pipeline, Product Hunt support.
